verdict.rationale: Recurly has no native natural-language interface in the product. Its documented route to natural-language operation is the Compass public MCP server, which lets external AI agents such as Claude Desktop or Cursor "work directly with Recurly's tools and APIs" [recurly-docs-24, recurly-probe-2]. However, it is also framed as connecting AI development tools to Recurly's documentation and API knowledge [recurly-docs-12], so it is unclear whether it can actually carry out account operations. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation confirming the MCP server can perform live account actions (e.g., changing subscriptions or issuing invoices) rather than only answering docs/API questions, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
